stories.headline: Governed multi-environment access for Claude Platform on AWS
stories.summary: AWS describes a governed design for reaching Claude Platform on AWS from multiple operating environments while keeping identity and environment boundaries explicit.
stories.why_it_matters: As model access spreads across developer machines and production workloads, identity, authorization and audit become part of the AI system rather than an afterthought.

visual.alt_text: Textbook architecture diagram showing developer and production environments passing through an identity boundary to Claude Platform on AWS, with approved access paths and an audit trail.

stories.headline: Gemini 4 Argon for long-horizon professional workflows
stories.summary: Google introduced Gemini 4 Argon for long-horizon software engineering, enterprise knowledge work and defensive cybersecurity, with access staged while safeguards are tested.
stories.why_it_matters: Longer-running model work increases the importance of bounded access, review checkpoints and evidence-backed expectations instead of treating benchmark headlines as a deployment plan.

visual.alt_text: Textbook workflow diagram showing a long-horizon task moving through planning, sustained execution, verification, and staged access for Gemini 4 Argon.

stories.headline: Personalization tied to decision and measurement loops
stories.summary: AWS presents a workflow combining generated content variants with contextual-bandit personalization and measurement across the acquisition funnel.
stories.why_it_matters: The useful pattern is the closed loop: generate alternatives, make an explicit decision, observe an outcome and feed evidence back into later choices.

visual.alt_text: Textbook closed-loop diagram showing audience context and generated variants entering a contextual bandit, a selected experience producing outcomes, and policy updates feeding later decisions.

stories.headline: Adapting production AI to organization-specific moderation policy
stories.summary: AWS describes how uniopen adapted Amazon Nova to its own retail moderation policy and evaluated the result before production deployment.
stories.why_it_matters: Organization-specific policy rarely fits a generic moderation layer perfectly; teams need labeled examples, explicit evaluation criteria and a review path that keeps policy ownership visible.

visual.alt_text: Textbook pipeline showing retail policy becoming labeled examples and evaluation criteria, Amazon Nova model adaptation, held-out evaluation, production moderation, and a review loop.

stories.headline: Perplexity business Skills package recurring work into reusable procedures
stories.summary: Perplexity and American Express introduced pre-built business Skills covering recurring finance, marketing, operations and hiring work; Skills package reusable instructions around required inputs and expected outputs.
stories.why_it_matters: For nontechnical teams, a maintained Skill turns repeated prompting into reusable operating knowledge that can be owned, reviewed and improved.

visual.alt_text: Textbook operating-knowledge diagram showing a reusable Business Skill with required inputs, instructions, expected output, four recurring business lanes, and a maintenance loop.
visual.mechanism: Story-specific accepted Run 4 professional editorial mechanism diagram.

stories.headline: OpenAI Dots assign persistent responsibilities to always-on agents
stories.summary: OpenAI introduced Dots as always-on agents with their own cloud computer, connected apps and feedback-driven personalization for continuing responsibilities.
stories.why_it_matters: Persistent agents shift the design question from one-off answers to ongoing responsibility: goals, permissions, review checkpoints, current-state context and feedback all need to remain understandable over time.

visual.alt_text: Textbook responsibility-loop diagram showing a persistent Dot receiving a goal, working through a bounded cloud computer and connected apps, returning outputs for review, and incorporating feedback.
